1-a.reviewMethod: Canonical-segment-aligned clause-by-clause translation and independent review; legacy English used only as a witness.
1-a.reviewerNotes: All 14 canonical segments were independently reviewed against the exact canonical Hebrew and mapped legacy chapter 1. Repetitions, false starts, bracketed turns, uncertainty markers, and source paragraph boundaries were preserved; witness-only additions were excluded. Segment-level source hashes and review findings are recorded in each segment's qa metadata.

1-b.reviewerNotes: All 16 canonical segments were translated and independently reviewed clause by clause against the exact canonical Hebrew and mapped legacy chapter 2; the legacy chapter was used only as a witness and was not approved wholesale. Four defects were corrected before merge (segments 1-b-003, 1-b-008, 1-b-010, and 1-b-015). Repetitions, false starts, bracketed turns, uncertainty markers, cutoffs, and source paragraph boundaries were preserved; witness-only additions and stage directions were excluded. Exact segment IDs, source hashes, checks, verdicts, and residual uncertainties are recorded in each segment's qa metadata.
